sentence: This project develops methods to understand, predict, and guide how people and robots adapt to each other through ongoing interaction.
This project tries to find out how sodium and potassium atoms act between layers of graphene and molybdenum disulfide.
This project studies how bilayer graphene can sense and tune the electronic states of a twisted thin material stacked near it.
This project brings together researchers to share recent advances in optimization, optimal control, and variational analysis.
This project studies how zinc oxide and titanium dioxide particles in sunscreens make reactive chemicals when exposed to sunlight and how seawater changes them.
This project builds algorithms that pull the genetic diversity of a particular microbial species out of mixed genetic data from environmental samples.
This project studies the structure and function of macromolecules, including membrane proteins, viruses and viral enzymes.
This project tests how well estimates of relatedness from genetic data can show how much genes influence animal behavior.
This project develops algorithms that let robots with multi-fingered hands grasp objects using images, based on object shape and appearance.
This project develops techniques that help self-driving cars make safe driving decisions despite deliberate attempts to disrupt them.
This project uses laser light to study negative ions, atoms with an extra electron, to learn how electrons interact with each other.
This project explores a technology that uses a protein overexpressed in many cancers for diagnosis, prognosis, and therapy.
This project combines eye tracking, audio, video, and neuroimaging data to find biomarkers of autism spectrum disorder.
This project works on tools that use artificial intelligence for early detection and support of children with speech and language processing challenges.
This project studies how cells keep nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide in balance and what happens to that balance as cells age.
This project builds an instrument that gives high resolution three-dimensional imaging of thick samples without staining.
This project studies how forests, streams, and mountain meadows respond to changes in climate and land-use decisions.
This project uses machine learning to improve the routing of qubits in quantum hardware.
